surface: plugin skills, template payload, AGENTS.md, pr_babysit helpers
summary: Address-pr-feedback skill: plate_get_unresolved_review_threads for fetch/done gate (includes outdated), per-thread resolve only, skill ships in template payload at .agentic/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md (#1155).
migration_impact: Bootstrapped repos receive `.agentic/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md`. Agents must use plate_get_unresolved_review_threads (or skill GraphQL fallback) for the zero-unresolved gate and plate_resolve_review_thread per thread after reply.
migration_guidance: 1. Re-bootstrap or re-import template payload to pick up `.agentic/skills/address-pr-feedback/SKILL.md`.
2. Follow the address-pr-feedback skill: fetch/re-query with plate_get_unresolved_review_threads; resolve each thread with plate_resolve_review_thread after its in-thread reply.
3. Do not use gh plate pr babysit --act as a per-thread resolver.
agent_notes: Done gate counts all isResolved:false threads including outdated. Babysit --act remains a separate bulk outdated auto-resolve (#605), not a substitute for the reply+resolve loop.
